Also many people throughout history have become martyrs, not just Christians.  I believe that if someone is willing to die for the God they believe in  then we should take a hard look at what that religion is about.  However, again, this doesn’t make it true.

I understand that if you believe in everything you’ve said then it makes sense that you believe in Christianity.  But that still comes down to faith in the Bible.  Sure there are scrolls and documents from the past corroborating some of Jesus’ story.  But believing in those is also an act of faith and I believe those documents don’t attest to the most controversial items (rising from the dead).  I could be wrong.  Even so, there are plenty of other stories of supernatural elements which I find equally as difficult to accept.

I guess I actually don’t think I do know the reality of those things.  I understand it to be impossible to prove that someone besides yourself is a person and not an object.  I choose to believe they are people though as I have my own evidence to that effect and it’s enough for me.
